subject: /workspaces/bmad-multi-user/skills/team-ready
verdict: Solid lean mutator with clean script placement; high findings cluster on Overview heading and incomplete headless propose/memlog contracts.
summary: team-ready is a tight set/propose skill with correct intelligence placement (frontmatter via script) and a right-sized customize.toml. Highest leverage fixes: add ## Overview, define headless propose as recommendation-only JSON with memlog audit trail, and surface soft_offer in headless set returns. The .memlog.md path-scan hit conflicts with builder process-memory conventions — do not move it into references/.

themes.title: Incomplete headless contracts
themes.root_cause: Set documents headless JSON; Propose and assumption logging do not, so automators dead-end or lose audit trail.
themes.action: Specify headless propose as recommendation-only JSON; wire memlog.py for assumptions; add soft_offer on PRD→ready set returns.

themes.title: Section contract vs destination prose
themes.root_cause: Destination content exists but is not under ## Overview, so integrity scanners and agents looking for the standard heading miss it.
themes.action: Rename/promote the opening destination block to ## Overview.

themes.title: Builder memlog vs path topology
themes.root_cause: Path-standards forbids non-SKILL.md markdown at root; workflow-builder keeps .memlog.md at skill root as process memory.
themes.action: Leave .memlog.md at root for this build; prefer scanner exclude for .memlog.md rather than relocating process memory.

themes.title: Light prose density
themes.action: Trim Constraints duplication, keep soft-offer only in Set, collapse Propose to a goal sentence, optional skip-confirm when explicit.

strengths: Deterministic frontmatter get/set isolated in artifact_status.py with tests
customize.toml universal-only is correct for an in-place mutator; SKILL.md reads {workflow.*}
Clear set vs propose intents; soft-offer team-drift without auto-start

recommendations.action: Add ## Overview and harden headless propose + memlog + soft_offer JSON in one pass
Leave .memlog.md; note path-scan false conflict for builder memlog
Optional: skip interactive confirm when path+status already explicit

journeys.name: Interactive set
journeys.steps: Activate → pick artifact → confirm status → script set → report → soft-offer team-drift if PRD ready

journeys.name: Interactive propose
journeys.steps: Activate → judge → recommend → wait accept → Set

journeys.name: Headless set
journeys.steps: Infer intent → script set → JSON complete (needs memlog/soft_offer fields)

experience.headless: Set path is sketched; Propose and assumption audit trail are incomplete for automators.

findings.title: Constraints restates Outcome bar
findings.evidence: Constraints repeats allowed statuses and --actor already in Outcome/Bar.
findings.recommendation: Keep only non-bar rules in Constraints (legacy mapping, no sidecar, no locks/vendor edits).

findings.title: Soft-offer team-drift lives in Bar and Set
findings.evidence: Soft-offer appears in Bar and Set step 4.
findings.recommendation: Remove soft-offer from Outcome Bar; keep in Set with do-not-auto-start.

findings.title: Propose numbering is decoration
findings.recommendation: Collapse Propose to one goal sentence.

findings.title: Missing ## Overview section
findings.evidence: Destination prose under # team-ready; integrity pre-pass flags Missing ## Overview.

findings.title: Markdown file at skill root
findings.recommendation: Builder process memory belongs at skill root per workflow-builder; treat scanner hit as known conflict — do not move to references/. Prefer excluding .memlog.md from path scan long-term.

findings.title: Headless Propose has no executable path
findings.evidence: Propose waits for accept; no headless JSON path.
findings.recommendation: Headless propose: recommendation-only JSON, no write; or mark propose interactive-only and blocked.

findings.title: Headless assumption trail not wired
findings.evidence: Says log assumption but no memlog.py path in JSON.
findings.recommendation: Append via memlog.py; include memlog path in headless JSON.

findings.title: Add headless memlog for assumptions
findings.evidence: No memlog init/append for headless assumptions; JSON omits memlog path.
findings.recommendation: Wire memlog.py for headless assumptions; return memlog path.

findings.title: Define headless propose contract
findings.evidence: Propose accept-gated; headless JSON only under Set.
findings.recommendation: Headless propose recommendation-only JSON; apply via separate set.

findings.title: Surface team-drift soft-offer in headless JSON
findings.evidence: Interactive soft-offer not in headless schema.
findings.recommendation: Add soft_offer: team-drift when PRD newly ready; do not auto-start.

findings.title: Skip Set confirm when utterance fully explicit
findings.evidence: Always confirms interactively even when path+status explicit.
findings.recommendation: Skip confirm when both named; keep when ambiguous.
